implementation_tree_policy: implementation_head is the first parent of the uniquely resolved policy commit. Because integration/source-locks.json pre-existed this OMPL authorization (introduced at the 6.0.1 baseline commit 63913b1), the unique policy commit is the schema-transition commit that introduces the repository-local OMPL authorization fields (repository, implementation_head, policy_commit_resolution) and whose parent blob lacks them; the raw path-history count is two, never a false count of one. The policy file is self-excluded from its own implementation-tree comparison and never self-references its containing commit hash. Qualification observes current status/diff/untracked bytes against this pre-authorized policy without creating or updating the policy file.
